t: This is University College School, a private day school in Frognal, Hampstead, often known as UCS. It was founded in 1830 by University College London. The philosopher Jeremy Bentham is named as its founder. He was an English jurist and social reformer, and is regarded as the founder of modern utilitarianism. So a school that is part of the story of London's university tradition, with a famous thinker attached to its beginnings.
